      Shockwave Pro-1000 Therapy

      Acoustic Wave Deep Tissue Regeneration

      Releases Frozen Shoulder adhesions, calcific heel spurs (Plantar Fasciitis), tennis elbow, and deep chronic muscle trigger knots using targeted acoustic pulses.

      🦴 NON-SURGICAL SLIP DISC CURE COMPUTERIZED TRACTION

      Robotic Spinal Decompression

      Imported Non-Surgical Disc Herniation Technology

      Gently creates negative intradiscal vacuum pressure at L4-L5 / L5-S1 to retract bulging discs and free pinched sciatic nerves without spine surgery.

      🦴 ADVANCED BONE & VERTEBRAL RELIEF BONE DECOMPRESSION

      Bone Decompression

      Multi-Axis Vertebral & Joint Decompression Table

      Relieves deep intervertebral bone compression, chronic lumbar stenosis, and cervical-thoracic joint stiffness through precision computerized alignment.

      🦵 KNEE ARTHRITIS & ALIGNMENT OA VALGUS / VARUS UNLOADER

      OA (Arthritis) Valgus

      Biomechanical Knee Joint Unloading & Correction

      Corrects bow-leg / knock-knee alignment (Varus/Valgus), widens narrowed knee joint space in Osteoarthritis (OA), and helps avoid total knee replacement surgery.
